newsitem.title: USA: U.S. housing starts dip sharply in December.
newsitem.headline: U.S. housing starts dip sharply in December.

text.p: Construction starts on new homes and apartments slowed sharply during December to the slowest rate in 1-1/2 years, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday, ending a strong building year on a weak note.
Total starts plunged 12.2 percent last month to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.329 million, the weakest building rate since 1.301 million in June 1995.
